answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can tie each identity to a bonded stake held in escrow, like a crystal vault that only opens after honest work. A new agent begins its voyage with a small reputation and must post collateral before it can trade; bad behavior slashes the bond. The velvet glove is that good agents earn the stake back with interest, while an attacker must fund thousands of separate bonds, turning cheap fake identities into an expensive losing bet.
